records.title: Shell jobs fail only when the worker runs as a service
records.report: Jobs exit immediately under systemd but run from an interactive terminal. Trace output reaches a console-cleanup command.

source.note: Primary first-person discussion reviewed through indexed source text. Outcome is reported, not independently reproduced.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Match the interactive PATH and working directory.
unsuccessfulSteps.evidence: The reporter said jobs still failed under the service.

unsuccessfulSteps.step: Use a repository-specific worker instead of a shared worker.

outcome.fix: The reporter removed the non-interactive console cleanup from the worker account’s logout profile.
outcome.verification: The original reporter marked the issue solved after identifying clear_console in the Debian logout profile.
outcome.limitations: Historical Debian behavior. Inspect the actual profile; do not run the service as root to bypass the problem.
